Work Description - Limited E-tender Bid Document For Provision Of Onboard Catering Services Intrains Without Pantry Car (through Tsv) For A Period Of 03 Months Further Extendable Upto 03 Month At Sole Discretion Of Irctc Or Finalization Commencement Of Long Term Tender

Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC), a Central Government Ministry/Department, invites limited e-tenders for the provision of onboard catering services for intra-trains without pantry cars (through TSV). The contract is for an initial period of 03 months, further extendable by an additional 03 months at the sole discretion of IRCTC, or until the finalization and commencement of a long-term tender. This tender, bearing reference number 2025/IRCTC/TSV/06/OCTOBER/07, is categorized as a service-based tender. Key dates include a document download and bid submission start date of October 1st, 2025, at 03:00 PM, and an end date for both document download and bid submission of October 7th, 2025, at 12:00 PM. The bid opening date is scheduled for October 7th, 2025, at 12:15 PM. The tender involves a two-cover system, encompassing technical and financial bids, and the tender value is ₹0.00, with no applicable EMD or tender fee. The Tender Inviting Authority is GGM/Procurement, located at 04th Floor, Tower-D, World Trade Centre Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110029. Bidders should refer to the tender documents for detailed specifications and requirements.
